title: Curtain Call motion pack
brief: A 5 s Curtain Call logo sting (16:9, 1:1, 9:16) with a sound logo, four lower thirds and two transition stingers an editor can drop into Premiere, all in the showtime brand.

round.label: Delivered · decision log
round.prompt: The pack shipped (D-015) and was fixed after review round 3 (D-017). The decisions that shaped it:
round.note: D-002 Concept: C1 "Velvet curtain" (3D curtains, mark flown in, lands in the pool) [picked] · D-003 Sound: bed-c1 direction (piano warmth); final sting uses a new logo-sting motif in D with its tonic on the landing [picked] · D-004 Lower thirds: Fraunces 900 names, Inter roles; cream text on Stage/Wings, velvet only as the bar [picked] · D-005 WebGL stinger: chromatic-split; the second stinger is the CSS curtain sweep [picked] · D-006 Do not replace brand sting v1: ship as a separate pack in the example folder [picked] · D-007 Frame rules from comments: frame 0 stays the slit of light; the mark rests square to camera; the wordmark sits on the dark apron, never on the gold pool [picked] · D-008 W1 Arcade marquee parked [picked] · D-009 Pace: skip the separate look and sound boards; next stop is one storyboard + animatic board, then lock [assumed] · D-010 Brand kit: canonical assets/brand/brand.json via SHOWTIME_BRAND; brand init --from <repo> draft rejected (wrong sources, see crew/brand/extractor-diff.md) [assumed] · D-011 Animatic approved: C1 locked at 5.0 s, landing at 2.8 s on the logo-sting tonic; build 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 plus the pack [picked] · D-012 Lower thirds keep honest placeholder names (names.json); pill dot enlarged from 2 to 2.6 cqmin [picked] · D-013 Locked. Build: three.js sting per aspect (native projects), lower thirds and stingers rendered with --alpha prores and --alpha webm [picked] · D-014 Review fixes: gold hem made visible (it sat below the boards and used reversed smoothstep edges); drape leading edges follow their folds [picked] · D-015 Pack shipped as example 20; sting v1 unchanged [picked] · D-016 Correction: the simulated feedback is restamped with the times each round was written and imported (21:39:52Z, 21:50:22Z, 22:07:43Z); the later feedback times quoted in D-002..D-015 were wrong [picked] · D-017 Review round 3 fixes: chromatic stinger clears by 0.92 s; role lines revealed only by the letter stagger; ProRes/WebM converted with the BT.709 matrix they are tagged with; whoosh hits on the cut; the same ~12 % slit on frame 0 in every layout; named 'Curtain Call motion pack sting' until v2 is adopted; softer wordmark wipe; earlier curtain start; dust kept in the beam [picked]

history.note: Review round 3 (critic): 1 blocker, 6 should-fix and 3 polish items fixed and re-rendered (D-017); the simulated feedback restamped with its real import times (D-016)
Shipped as example 20 (D-015); the decision log D-002..D-015 is on this page

Built and checked: three native sting renders (qa PASS, -14.0 LUFS, -1.5 dBTP); self-review fixed the curtain hem and the drapes' straight edges; pill dot enlarged (your note on LT-4); final 1:1 and 9:16 frames added to C1

C1 picked (D-002). Storyboard (4 shots, 5.0 s) and a half-size animatic with the real mix; wordmark moved onto the dark apron and the mark rests square (your notes on C1-1/C1-3); lower thirds (4) and stingers (2) added as LT and TR
Four directions for the sting (3 + wildcard), a 10 s bed each, and four build questions

concepts.title: Velvet curtain
concepts.logline: A real 3D stage: velvet curtains part, the mark is flown in from the flies and lands in the spotlight pool.
concepts.hook: Frame 0: a slit of gold light between closed velvet curtains.
concepts.why: The only direction that is true 3D, and it acts out the brand idea itself: the curtain opens, the show starts.

music.vibe: piano, then the logo motif on the landing

concepts.risk: Heaviest to render (WebGL); the mark moves in 3D, so it must come to rest square to camera (brand: no rotated mark).

storyboard.title: Slit of light
storyboard.note: Frame 0: closed velvet, a slit of gold; the pool is already lit (feed thumbnail). Sound: piano pickup, low D drone.

storyboard.title: Curtains part
storyboard.note: 0.3-2.3: the drapes travel open, the hem trails the top; the camera dollies in 7 %. Sound: heavy whoosh of velvet.

storyboard.title: Flown in, lands
storyboard.note: 2.05-2.8: the mark is flown in from the flies and lands in the pool at 2.8, square to camera; the pool flares once. Sound: logo-sting tonic + thock on the landing, piano chorus downbeat.

storyboard.title: Wordmark + hold
storyboard.note: 3.05: the wordmark wipes up on the dark apron, readable from 3.85, holds to 5.0. Sound: shimmer, piano fades.

concepts.title: Marquee
concepts.logline: A lit theatre marquee: bulbs chase around an empty board, then the mark and wordmark light up inside it.
concepts.hook: Chasing bulbs on a dark board, one word: tonight.
concepts.risk: Flat 2D; close to a generic 'coming soon' sign

concepts.title: Spotlight
concepts.logline: No curtain: one follow-spot searches a dark stage and finds the mark.
concepts.hook: A cone of light rakes across empty boards.

music.vibe: ambient pad, swell into the hit

concepts.risk: Mostly dark frames: weakest thumbnail in a feed

concepts.title: Arcade marquee
concepts.logline: An 8-bit marquee says now showing; the board pixel-dissolves into the mark.
concepts.hook: A pixel marquee chasing: NOW SHOWING, PRESS START.
concepts.risk: Pixelating the mark is an effect on the artwork (BRAND.md don'ts): only the transition may touch it, never the resting mark

concepts.title: Lower thirds (pack)
concepts.logline: Four variants for Premiere, 6 s each with alpha: bar (velvet bar), card (Wings card, gold rule), kicker (gold badge), pill (gold dot). Names in Fraunces 900, roles in Inter with an anime.js letter stagger.
concepts.hook: Name readable within 0.6 s of the entrance.
concepts.risk: Sample names are placeholders (names.json); the preview plate is a sting frame, the renders are transparent

concepts.title: Transition stingers (pack)
concepts.logline: Two 1 s stingers with alpha, fully covered at the cut point: a CSS curtain sweep, and a velvet drape that turns into the lit stage through the WebGL chromatic-split.
concepts.hook: Cut under the velvet at 0.5 s (curtain) or 0.45 s (chromatic).
concepts.risk: The shader draws opaque pixels, so its window sits between two full-frame plates; the ends are CSS moves

audio.label: Concept beds
audio.hint: 10 s each, all mastered to -14 LUFS; C1 and C3 include their sound-logo moment

variants.label: C3 pad + swell
variants.meta: ambient-pad · D · swell into a hit at 6.0 s
